prompt: What is Solr 9.x's default per-field similarity class (the actual class name)? One short answer.
notes: BM25SimilarityFactory is the default; SchemaSimilarityFactory wraps it for per-field overrides

prompt: For a single term-field match in BM25, name the three multiplicative components that produce the per-clause score. Comma-separated, no other text.
What does the BM25 k1 parameter control? One sentence using the word 'saturation' or 'frequency'.
notes: k1 controls term frequency saturation rate

prompt: What does the BM25 b parameter control? One sentence using the word 'length' or 'normalization'.
I want my title field to use BM25 with k1=0.4 b=0.0 (no length penalty) but the description field to use defaults. Show the schema XML for the title fieldType's <similarity> element.
notes: Per-fieldType <similarity> with named float params; global must be SchemaSimilarityFactory for per-field to work

prompt: I added a per-fieldType <similarity> in my schema but it has no effect. The global similarity is set to BM25SimilarityFactory directly. Why doesn't per-field override work, and what's the fix? Two sentences.
notes: Global must be SchemaSimilarityFactory (the default) to delegate to per-field overrides

prompt: In a Solr BooleanQuery, which clause types contribute to the final score? List all that do, comma-separated.
notes: MUST and SHOULD score; MUST_NOT and FILTER don't

prompt: In eDisMax, the bf parameter combines with the base score by being ADDED to it. True or false? One word.
notes: bf is additive: final_score = base_score + bf_value

prompt: In eDisMax, the boost parameter is multiplicative. If base score is 15 and boost=if(in_stock_b,1.0,0.5), what's the final score for an in-stock doc and an out-of-stock doc? Two numbers.
Common-term query produces base scores around 50. I add bf=log(sum(popularity_i,1)) which evaluates to 1-5 per doc. Why does the boost have no visible effect on ranking? One sentence.
notes: Additive boost of 1-5 against base of 50 is noise; switch to multiplicative boost=

prompt: What is a judgment list (in the context of search relevancy tuning)? One sentence.
notes: Judgment list = queries paired with rated/ranked relevant docs, used to compute metrics

prompt: What does NDCG@10 measure? One short sentence.
notes: NDCG@10 measures how well top-10 ranking matches the ideal/labeled ranking
